sources.title: GPT-6.1 Sol API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact undated model ID and only listed snapshot; 1,050,000-token context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output; text/image inputs and text output. Lists reasoning efforts low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max; tool calling requires Responses. No parameter count or architecture is specified. Parameter-only re-audit October 27 reopened the full exact model reference from the HTTP 200 retrieval at 16:22 UTC; it supplies no nominal total or active count.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 entry explicitly releases gpt-6.1-sol in Responses and Chat Completions, with tool calling through Responses. October 8 introduces Ultrafast using the same model ID and service_tier setting; that is a later processing tier, not this model’s first release.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete official launch through the web index October 27; the direct-cache request returned HTTP 403. It explicitly calls GPT-6.1 Sol an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol and compares it with Astra on capability, price and task cost. It publishes no total/active count and identifies no counted base from which a nominal size could be inherited. Launch availability covers Work, Codex and API, with Chat excluded; it names coding, computer use and professional work as intended uses.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.evidence: Full original September 29 PDF freshly fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC and reopened for this pass. Introduction identifies GPT-6.1 as the latest GPT-6 family; section 2 says the same types of data and training as Astra, without identifying Astra as a weight base. Inspected introduction, training and comparison tables and searched the full text for count/architecture terms; no nominal total or activated count was found.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card
sources.evidence: Full Astra PDF freshly fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC and reopened, including the training discussion referenced by Sol and full-text parameter, billion/trillion, distillation and base-model checks. Training-code, hyperparameter and open-source-base references describe evaluation workloads, not Sol parameters. No counted Sol base or transferable numerical size was identified.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: October 26 later card freshly fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC and reopened. Exact GPT-6.1 Sol columns in production benchmarks (Table 22), biological capability tables, biological refusal (Table 31) and cybersecurity safety (Table 32), plus monitorability comparisons, report behavior and scores rather than total/active parameters. Full-text count checks found no specification. Shared training/safeguards and later-version comparison caveats do not establish a counted base.

sources.title: Suppressing misalignment monitoring alerts and disabling misalignment monitoring
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the original October 20 report through the web index October 27. It identifies the October 3 GPT-6.1 Sol incident separately from the October 6 Astra incident; the monitoring policy excerpt still replaces the numerical size threshold with [the specified size threshold]. No total, active count or usable numerical lower bound is disclosed.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide describes cached key-value states and explicitly includes GPT-6.1 Sol pricing and examples. KV states alone do not specify Transformer topology, dense versus mixture-of-experts structure, or total/active parameters.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived February 18 recipe explicitly applies only to models before GPT-5.6. Its Transformer-layer explanation is therefore excluded as evidence for GPT-6.1 Sol.

sources.title: EU AI Act: OpenAI Resources and Customer Guidance
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the current training-summary directory October 27. It lists an Astra summary but no exact GPT-6.1 Sol summary. The Astra summary was separately read as s18; neither that document nor the index establishes a Sol parameter count or counted-base lineage.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Vision-capable models accept PDF files through the API, which extracts text and page images. This supports retaining PDF as an accepted input format alongside the model’s native text/image modalities; PDF is not an independent neural modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service/API access and reserve service intellectual property. Together with the hosted release and official separation of open-weight models, this supports a descriptive Proprietary classification, not an SPDX weight license. Retrieved through the web index; separate direct HTTP returned 403.

sources.title: All OpenAI models
sources.evidence: Lists GPT-6.1 Sol among flagship models; separately identifies gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as open-weight releases under Apache 2.0. No GPT-6.1 Sol weight distribution is listed.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Current document checked for the exact gpt-6.1-sol identifier; no retirement notice was found. This supports a documentation check only and does not establish successful endpoint operation.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-6.1 Sol record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead independently read. Its gpt-sol family is less specific than the first-party GPT-6.1 family statement. Its date, context and supported input formats agree with the primary sources; it is not used to establish undisclosed internals.

sources.title: Using GPT-6: GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.evidence: Fresh official documentation search and retrieval October 27. The exact Sol section describes capability, price and supported reasoning effort, with a link to its model reference. It provides no nominal total/active parameter count or named weight-base relationship; API request parameters are not neural-network parameter counts.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the full later first-party launch October 27. Exact GPT-6.1 Sol comparisons concern task performance, prices, token efficiency and completion times. No total/activated parameter column, nominal size or counted Sol lineage is supplied.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra Public Summary of Training Content
sources.evidence: Original v1 summary dated September 2, freshly fetched HTTP 200 October 27 at 15:42 UTC and read for this pass. It identifies Astra alone and says Astra is not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model. Its more-than-10-trillion text-token range and other data-volume ranges are training content, not parameters; no Sol count can be inherited.

name.note: Exact display name. The listed API alias is gpt-6.1-sol; no dated snapshot is listed.

developer.note: Official announcement and system card identify OpenAI.

family.note: The original card explicitly identifies GPT-6.1 as the family within the broader GPT-6 series; replace the catalog’s gpt-sol label.

release_date.note: Explicit September 29 API release. Launch also covered Work and Codex. The October 8 Ultrafast addition is a processing tier, not the release date.

open_weights.note: Documented release is a proprietary hosted service; the official inventory separately identifies open-weight releases and provides no Sol weights.

license.note: Descriptive licensing classification based on hosted distribution and retained service IP; not a named open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: October 27 parameter-only re-audit found no published nominal total after reopening the exact API reference, launch, original Sol/Astra cards, later Terra comparison columns and launch, monitoring report and training summaries. Bounded fresh searches for exact-model parameter, billion/trillion and research-comparison disclosures found no count-bearing primary source. The launch names an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, but no counted base was established; shared Astra training types do not identify a weight base. Price, task scores, training-data volumes and the omitted monitoring threshold supply no literal count.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name searches for active/activated parameters and later model-team comparisons found no supported nominal active count. Exact Sol columns in the later Terra card report safety and capability metrics, not activated parameters; the Terra launch compares cost and performance. No counted-base active convention was established. Do not infer active parameters from total size, price, throughput or behavioral capacity.

architecture.note: No exact GPT-6.1 Sol structural specification was found in the inspected original/later cards or targeted first-party training, interpretability and engineering results. Shared training types/safeguards with Astra do not establish topology. Current KV caching is insufficient, the Transformer recipe excludes GPT-5.6 and later, and the EU summary index has no exact Sol entry.

context_window.note: Total advertised token window; the same exact-model page separately states 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is retained as an API file format processed into text and page images; native audio/video are unsupported.

reasoning.note: Reasoning tokens and low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max efforts are documented. None and minimal are outside the supported list; do not transfer the GPT-6 Sol/Luna none setting.

tool_call.note: Function calling and built-in tools are supported through Responses. Chat Completions supports requests without tools; the earlier Sol/Luna Chat Completions none-effort exception is not applied here.

description.value: GPT-6.1 reasoning model for coding, computer use and professional work, with text and image input.
description.note: Plain supported purpose and capabilities replace a broad relative-performance and price claim.

patch.notes: Released September 29, 2026 in API, Work and Codex; Chat was excluded at launch. The only listed API snapshot is the undated gpt-6.1-sol identifier. Context is 1,050,000 tokens, with 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. Reasoning supports low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max; tool calling requires Responses. PDF input is converted to text and page images. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked sources; no counted base is identified. Architecture is unverified. Ultrafast was added October 8 as a service tier of the same model.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh original-source, later exact-Sol comparison, engineering and training-summary checks. No published nominal count or counted-base lineage was established. Add explicit null parameter patches and parameters_source; preserve the other 12 assessments and their original supported corrections.
